gre_general.value: GRE General is required unless you will already hold a degree from a US or Canadian institution by the time you enrol, so most applicants from India must sit it.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are required for all other applicants.

also.quote: GRE General Test scores are not required for applicants who will have received a degree from an institution located in the U.S. or Canada by the time of enrollment.

supervisor.value: Admission is granted by the department, not to a faculty member's research group, so you do not need a supervisor's agreement to apply.
supervisor.quote: Tufts offers a PhD program in Computer Science, with admission granted at the department level, not to individual faculty members’ research groups.

deadline.value: Fall 2027 PhD applications are due December 15, 2026; the official table prints no year.

gre_subject.value: The official programme page states no subject GRE rule.

funding.value: The School of Engineering says full-time PhD students often receive a tuition scholarship; the page does not say that most are funded.

also.quote: Full-time PhD students within the School of Engineering often receive a tuition scholarship.

entry_route.value: The official programme page does not say whether a bachelor's or a master's is needed.

notes: The Human-Robot Interaction doctorate is a joint PhD with Mechanical and ECE; its own page is not used for field values here. The programme lists machine-learning research areas, but no separate data-science, AI or ML PhD exists, so no datasci record. Competitive TOEFL 100 / IELTS 7.5 are not minimums and are not used.
